# Native distillation-window reference graph

The manifest, canonical Float32 weights and 256-delivery inference reference
were generated by Rust's `canonical-training-graph` tool at Slither commit
`a965538c5db41d22d494e0d524c908ec5b1b1850`. The receipt records the exact source,
compiler/target, graph/sensor/equation digests and every numeric role digest.

The graph is v4 Basic B8: Input72 -> custom GRU8 -> Dense2, with Preserve life
state and a 0.06-second deployment cadence. Observations repeat bounded rows
from the synthetic native teacher-codec reference. These are codec/optimizer
and restart tests; they make no committed-gameplay or imitation-quality claim.

`request.json` uses only relative input paths. To reproduce into an absent output:

```sh
canonical-training-graph request.json /path/to/new-reference
```

Do not overwrite the fixture to hide a parity failure. CPU/CUDA window tests
perform actual updates and full optimizer/RNG/checkpoint restarts with it.
